nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Integrated PM-JAY and Tamil Nadu CMCHIS health assurance arrangement for eligible beneficiaries, using a common government-funded hospitalization framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on the applicable PM-JAY/CMCHIS beneficiary category and current Tamil Nadu implementation rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under PMJAY–CMCHIS (Tamil Nadu).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
